calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year 
FROM dim_date 
WHERE calendar_date >= '2023-01-01'
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(DISTINCT wo.web_order_id) as orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wo.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN wo.web_order_id END) as click_and_collect_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wo.fulfilment_type = 'home_delivery' THEN wo.web_order_id END) as home_delivery_orders
FROM fact_web_order wo
JOIN dim_date d ON DATE(wo.order_ts_utc) = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, d.fiscal_period DESC

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wo.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN wo.order_total_gross ELSE 0 END) as click_and_collect_value,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wo.fulfilment_type = 'home_delivery' THEN wo.order_total_gross ELSE 0 END) as home_delivery_value,
  SUM(wo.order_total_gross) as total_web_sales
FROM fact_web_order wo
JOIN dim_date d ON DATE(wo.order_ts_utc) = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, d.fiscal_period DESC

SELECT 
  status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) as order_count,
  SUM(order_total_gross) as total_value
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE web_order_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY order_count DESC

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  wo.fulfilment_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT wo.web_order_id) as order_count,
  SUM(wo.order_total_gross) as sales_value
FROM fact_web_order wo
JOIN dim_date d ON DATE(wo.order_ts_utc) = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
  AND wo.status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, wo.fulfilment_type
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period DESC, wo.fulfilment_type

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wo.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN wo.order_total_gross ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(wo.order_total_gross), 2) as click_and_collect_share_pct
FROM fact_web_order wo
JOIN dim_date d ON DATE(wo.order_ts_utc) = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
  AND wo.status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year

WITH web_sales_by_fulfilment AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    wo.fulfilment_type,
    SUM(wo.order_total_gross) as sales_value
  FROM fact_web_order wo
  JOIN dim_date d ON DATE(wo.order_ts_utc) = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
    AND wo.status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, wo.fulfilment_type
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN sales_value ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
    SUM(sales_value), 
    2
  ) as click_and_collect_share_pct
FROM web_sales_by_fulfilment
GROUP BY fiscal_year
